convertibility_reason: Heavy pending order management with order iteration, position selection, and volume capping logic. Multi-symbol concurrent execution with intrabar M30 and daily D1 trading. Volume adjustment based on existing orders/positions requires precise MT5 order book state. Signal logic is encapsulated in CExp class methods (DayTrade/IntraDayTrade) which are stubs - actual logic unknown but framework supports complex order management.

other_exits: TP and order type determined by CExp::getTP() and CExp::getOrderType() which are stubs

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Volume calculated by CExp::getVol(). DebugOrderSend enforces: max 15 lots cumulative per symbol per direction, max 5 lots per order, min 0.1 lots, rejects if below SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN. Pending order volume is reduced if cumulative position+orders would exceed 15 lots.

custom_logic_notes: CExp class methods (DayTrade, IntraDayTrade, getTP, getVol, getOrderType, getDB, Init) are declared but not implemented - trading logic is stubbed. DebugOrderSend acts as a risk wrapper around OrderSend: caps cumulative pending orders at 12, enforces SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN/5-lot max, prevents stacking same-direction pending orders beyond 15 lots total. DebugOrderCheck similarly validates before OrderCheck. The EA trades 5 symbols simultaneously (USDCHF, GBPUSD, AUDUSD, USDJPY, EURGBP). D1 bar triggers DayTrade, M30 bar triggers IntraDayTrade. IsNewBar uses static datetime array indexed by period.
python_conversion_notes: Core trading logic (CExp class) is unimplemented in this file - cannot convert without the full implementation. DebugOrderSend/DebugOrderCheck logic requires replicating MT5 order book iteration (cumulative volume per symbol per direction across positions+pending orders). Multi-symbol concurrent execution needs per-symbol position tracking. The 12-pending-order cap and 15-lot cumulative cap are broker-specific limits that need parameterization in Python. IsNewBar logic with static array indexing is fragile (only handles 2 periods via int _=period==PERIOD_M30).
